json.justification: The meter is on an exterior side wall with clear blank wall space beside it for the disconnect and a short conduit route. Along the same side wall there is a long open grassy area with full overhead clearance; a battery can be placed away from the garage/driveway and the visible ground-level window, with wiring run along the wall without crossing a door or garage.
